user.title: Where do you fish?
user.description: Search for a place by name. Leave this empty to enter coordinates instead.

pick.title: Which place?
pick.description: Choose the closest match, or enter coordinates yourself.

manual.title: Coordinates
manual.description: The forecast is computed for exactly this point.

spot.title: Describe the water
spot.description: The defaults suit a small lake. The more accurate this is, the better the forecast.

data_description.water_body: How big and deep the water is decides how fast it warms and cools.
data_description.tide_range_m: Typical difference between high and low water. Only used for tidal water.
data_description.catchment: How quickly the land turns rain into muddy water.
data_description.elevation: Leave empty to use the elevation of the weather model.
data_description.pressure_source: Sea-level pressure suits most spots. Use station pressure only if you will rely on a local barometer.
data_description.water_temp_entity: Optional. A real probe sets the water temperature; the model still supplies the trend.

species.title: What are you fishing for?
species.description: You can change this later from the species selector.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the place search. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_results: No place found with that name. Try another spelling, or leave it empty to enter coordinates.

abort.already_configured: A spot at these coordinates is already set up.

shelter.title: Shelter from the wind
shelter.description: How exposed is the bank to wind from each direction? 0 is fully sheltered, 1 is open water with a long fetch.

data_description.bank_aspect_deg: Compass bearing in degrees, towards the water. Optional; used to tell an onshore wind from an offshore one.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the latest weather now and re-score every fishing spot.
